p: After Absalom had polluted it with most filthy fornication.
for thou hast lifted me up: He condemns them for great ingratitude who do not praise God for his benefits.
healed me: Restored from the rebellion of Absalom.
soul from the grave: Meaning, that he escaped death most narrowly.
saints of his: The word signifies them who have received mercy, and show mercy liberally to others.
prosperity I said: I put too much confidence in my quiet state as in Jer 31:18, 2Ch 32:24,25.
mountain to stand strong: I thought you had established me in Zion most surely.
was troubled: After you had withdrawn your help, I felt my misery.
dust praise thee: David means that the dead are not profitable to the congregation of the Lord here in the earth: therefore he would live to praise his Name, which is the end of man's creation.
glory may sing praise to thee: Because you have preserved me that my tongue should praise you, I will not be unmindful of my duty.
